key_insight: ROPD realigns compromised LLMs by matching output distributions instead of prompt templates, making safety defenses more robust to unseen attacker prompting.
engineering_relevance: For production LLMs, this offers a practical route to preserve task skills while reducing harmful behavior under template mismatch and prompt-switch attacks.
method: Models the divergence between aligned and compromised output probability distributions
Uses routing-based on-policy distillation rather than template-specific fitting
Targets robust realignment while minimizing catastrophic forgetting
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates ROPD against four baselines across three datasets and three base models, showing stronger defense performance and better capability preservation under template mismatches.
watch_item: ROPD is improved but not fully invariant to prompt-template shifts, so some degradation can still occur under distributional changes.
paper_title: On-Policy Distillation for LLM Safety: A Routing Approach to Template-Robust Realignment
